text:
Hey, we started the process from London and it was pretty smooth. 
The embassy was helpful and efficient, and it took about 1.5 months to get the permission to enter . I can DM you the contact details for someone that we dealt with directly. 

If you haven’t already, I’d recommend registering your marriage with the Israeli embassy in the UK before starting the process. 
We submitted the online application as soon as we landed in Israel so the documents were still valid.

For proof of previous marital status, we used a “Certificate of No Trace” from the General Register Office (you need to call to request it). It was accepted both by the embassy and in Tel Aviv
